name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It’s the fastest way to surface real issues without disrupting workflows. The trade-off is delayed feedback on older PRs, but speed beats completeness here.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on open PRs risks normalizing noise in reviews, training reviewers to ignore PR-Agent output over time. Instead, run it on a closed PR first to validate its signal-to-noise ratio before exposing teams to it. Settle this by measuring how often PR-Agent flags real issues vs. false positives in a test run.
